project: Faithful SAGE reproduction — iterative, activation-grounded SAE-feature explanation vs. Neuronpedia
direction: SAGE (multi-agent propose→test→revise pipeline over an SAE dictionary) produces natural-language explanations that outperform Neuronpedia on generative and predictive accuracy across multiple LLM+SAE pairs and early-to-late layers.

journey_summary.claim: 1 faithful-capture idea (behavior_source=given) → 4 claims (C1-C4) targeting generative + predictive accuracy on the main pair, layer-depth generalization, and cross-LLM+SAE-pair generalization.
journey_summary.mechanism_routing: family=Feature Dictionary Learning / SAE, submethod=SAE-feature auto-interpretation (Explainer→Designer→Analyzer→Reviewer loop) — no Screen (SAE feature ids ARE the located units), Decode via SAGE loop, Verify via paired generative + predictive assays.
journey_summary.experiment: 5 runs, 1.66 GPU-hours (of 10-hour budget), headline: mixed — C1 partial (attribution-confounded), C2/C3 null (under-powered), C4 positive-trend (under-powered).
journey_summary.verify: 4 claims: 1 PASS (C4) / 0 FAIL / 0 INCONCLUSIVE / 0 ZEV / 3 INTEGRITY_ONLY (cap=3, swap_off=0); integrity[Phase2/Phase9]: WARN/PASS.
journey_summary.iteration: 1/6 iteration (0/2 claim-reentries consumed — only type-⓪ narrative-only), score 6/10 verdict almost, termination=positive_verdict (three-dimensional STOP rule fired on entry).
journey_summary.figures: 4 tables across 4 claims; 0 judgment-skipped; 0 render-skipped, 0 errored.

open_items: Attribution confound (M0.5-flagged): single-pass GPT-5 already outscores Neuronpedia's GPT-4o-mini baseline, so C1's beat over Neuronpedia is NOT attributable to the SAGE loop itself (Δ vs matched-backbone = -0.005 n.s.). Reviewer type-⓪ paper-side recommendation: split into C1a (vs public Neuronpedia older-backbone catalog) + C1b (vs matched-backbone GPT-5-1shot, promote in abstract).

DMXAPI throughput variance (occasional 10-20 min stalls per call) was the wall-clock bottleneck — realized n at ~15% of planned for M1 (44/300), ~15% for C3 per-layer (14-15/100), ~23% for M2 (34/150). All four claims tagged suspected_under_power (UNDERPOWER=tag).

C1 verify swap-test deferred (max_verify_claims cap): upgrade via /auto-verify C1 — resume: true, swap-variants: true. **Highest reviewer priority** (~1 GPU-hr) — closes the attribution-confound argument.
C2 verify swap-test deferred (max_verify_claims cap): upgrade via /auto-verify C2 — resume: true, swap-variants: true. Second priority.

C3 verify swap-test deferred (max_verify_claims cap): upgrade via /auto-verify C3 — resume: true, swap-variants: true. Lowest priority (underlying issue is under-power, not integrity); combine with a larger M1 n_features_per_layer + L20 l0_71 SAE swap.
L20 SAE l0 alignment looser than L4/L12; l0_71 variant available but not swapped in — potential noise source on C3-L20.
M2 scope-narrowed at experiment stage to predictive-only + SAGE-lite (no Designer+Analyzer) on Qwen3-4B; full-SAGE + generative-accuracy on Qwen3-4B never tested.
Paper-side wording checklist (all type ⓪, execution is paper author's responsibility) — see review-stage/AUTO_ITERATION_FINAL_REPORT.md §Paper-side wording checklist.

claims.statement: On Gemma-2-2B + gemmascope-res-16k, SAGE explanations trigger the target feature more reliably than Neuronpedia's on paired same-feature-id probe texts (paired 95% CI lower bound > 0).
claims.origin: task.md (given behavior) — generative-accuracy half of the SAGE claim

data.available_n: 16k features × 26 layers; ~50k activating snippets per feature
data.used_n: 44 features × 5 probe texts (planned: 300 × 5); ~15% of planned scale
data.subset_note: under-powered due to DMXAPI throughput variance

claims.method: Milestone M1 — paired bootstrap 95% CI on (SAGE − Neuronpedia) generative-accuracy per feature; matched-backbone GPT-5-1shot attribution control (M0.5).

main_experiment.key_stats: Δgen_acc (SAGE − Neuronpedia) = +0.018, 95% CI [+0.005, +0.036], Wilcoxon p=0.045; but Δgen_acc (SAGE − GPT-5-1shot) = -0.005, n.s.
main_experiment.headline: SAGE beats Neuronpedia's public GPT-4o-mini explanations by +1.8pp gen_acc, but gain is attributable to backbone upgrade — no significant advantage over matched-backbone GPT-5-1shot control.

iteration.narrowed_to: SAGE's +1.8pp beat is over the *specific* public Neuronpedia catalog (an older-backbone historical baseline), NOT over a matched-backbone control — the pipeline itself does not produce a significant loop-only gain at n=44

claims.final_status: ⚪ integrity_only [WARN — audit passed with warnings, swap-test deferred (max_verify_claims cap)]; iteration narrowed the claim: the Neuronpedia-beat is a backbone-upgrade artifact, matched-backbone loop-only Δ ≈ 0

figures.caption: C1 headline metric — SAGE vs. Neuronpedia public catalog vs. matched-backbone GPT-5-1shot control on generative accuracy. The +1.8pp SAGE-vs-Neuronpedia gain (CI excludes 0) is not attributable to the SAGE loop: SAGE − GPT-5-1shot Δ ≈ 0.
